subject: Request: EU data sovereignty, SCCs, VPC design and DPIA summary
messages:
From: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@helixhealth.de>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.de
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 08:22:00 +02:00
Subject: EU processing scope, VPC + DPIA materials request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're interested in proceeding but need written confirmation on a few items before we can move to procurement:

1) EU-only processing — our legal team requires an explicit commitment that Helix customer data (including logs and generated outputs) will be processed and stored only within EU data centers for the production workload. Please state whether Redwood can commit to EU-only processing for our tenant, and whether that commitment is contractual (DPA/SCCs) or operational (regional routing + controls).

2) VPC / private networking — we need an outline of the VPC architecture and the connectivity options (private peering, AWS PrivateLink, or VPN). We also need to know whether private deployments support customer-managed KMS/HSM and if audit logs are exported to our Splunk instance.

3) DPIA support — Helix is required to complete a DPIA. Can Redwood provide a DPIA summary or template showing data flows, categories, retention, subprocessors, and risk mitigations we can use as input?

4) SCCs & evidence — please confirm Redwood's SCC status and provide any signed SCC addendum or equivalent. We also need SOC 2 evidence (Type II report) and the CAIQ/consensus answers to the SIG questionnaire for our security team to review.

Timing: we are aiming to have procurement approvals in the next two weeks. Can you indicate realistic delivery dates for the artifacts above?

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,
Anna Schmidt
Head of Security & Privacy Operations
Helix Health GmbH
anna.schmidt@helixhealth.de
+49 30 555 1234
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@helixhealth.de>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.de, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 14:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: EU processing scope, VPC + DPIA materials request

Hi Anna — great to hear. Short answers up front and next steps below.

- EU-only processing: Yes — we can enforce region-bound processing for Helix's production tenant. That is enforced operationally (region pinning + smart routing) and we can put the commitment in the DPA/SCC addendum.
- VPC & networking: We support AWS VPC peering, PrivateLink, and site-to-site VPN for Dedicated/Private deployments. Customer-managed KMS is available for Private deployments; audit logs can be forwarded to your Splunk collector.
- DPIA: We do not replace your DPIA but can provide a DPIA summary including data flows, subprocessors, retention, and mitigations.
- SCCs / SOC 2 / CAIQ: We will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II cover letter (redacted where necessary), a completed CAIQ/consensus matrix, and a draft SCC addendum for signature.

I attached a short VPC architecture diagram and a 1-page summary of our EU region controls to speed your security review.

Proposed next step: technical sync w/ your infra/security team on Tue or Wed this week (30 min) to walk the VPC options and KMS specifics. After that, our legal/security teams will share the DPA/SCCs and DPIA summary.

Available slots (CEST): Tue 13 Apr 09:00–11:00 or Wed 14 Apr 14:00–16:00. Which works?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_vpc_architecture.pdf (figures/diagram, 1 page); eu_controls_onepager.pdf (stub)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:40:00 +00:00
Subject: FW: Helix request — SCCs, DPIA summary, VPC confirmations (need language + artifacts)

Team — forwarding Helix's asks (below). Procurement wants a firm timeline for the deliverables. Can Legal/Security: 1) confirm whether the EU-only processing commitment can be expressed as a contractual clause in the DPA/SCC addendum; 2) provide the signed SCCs template or an addendum draft we can send; 3) produce a concise DPIA summary (2–3 pages) that covers data flows and mitigations we can hand to the customer; 4) confirm what we can share for SOC2/CAIQ (redacted versions ok).

If possible, please prepare the DPA/SCC addendum draft and DPIA summary by end-of-day Tue 13 Apr so we can get back to Helix ahead of their procurement window.

Thanks — Karthik
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:12:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: FW: Helix request — SCCs, DPIA summary, VPC confirmations (need language + artifacts)

Hi all — quick answers and deliverables.

1) EU-only processing: Yes — we can add a clear operational commitment and a contractual clause in the DPA that states Helix tenant data will be processed and stored only in the EU region(s) designated in the order. We'll include an SLA-style routing guarantee and fallback behavior (i.e., failover region is also EU).

2) SCCs & DPA: I attached a draft SCC addendum (SCCs-addendum-draft.docx) tailored for EU-only processing and the standard DPA template (dpa-template.pdf). Please review but these are ready to send for initial review. If Helix requires an executed SCCs PDF, we can route a DocuSign link once countersigned.

3) DPIA summary: Lauren — can you produce a 2–3 page DPIA summary covering: data categories, subprocessors, retention, encryption/KMS approach, network isolation, and risk mitigations? Target EOD Wed 14 Apr. I will review.

4) SOC 2 / CAIQ / SIG: We can share our SOC 2 Type II cover letter and a redacted report under an NDA; the CAIQ can be provided as a completed spreadsheet. Marissa — can you prepare the CAIQ export and indicate if anything needs redaction?

Deliverables planned:
- Tue 13 Apr EOD: SCCs addendum draft, DPA template (attached)
- Wed 14 Apr EOD: DPIA summary (Lauren)
- Wed 14 Apr midday: CAIQ export (Marissa)

Attachments: sccs-addendum-draft.docx; dpa-template.pdf

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Anna Schmidt <anna.schmidt@helixhealth.de>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.de
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: EU processing scope, VPC + DPIA materials request

Hi Karthik — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming next steps from our side:

- We'll take Tue 13 Apr 09:00 CEST for the tech sync (your calendar invite shows 09:00, I'll join with our infra lead).
- Procurement will review the DPA/SCC draft as soon as you send the DocuSign link for execution. We prefer DocuSign for signatures.
- For the DPIA: Helix will run its internal DPIA but requests Redwood's DPIA summary by Tue 20 Apr so we can incorporate it into our report. Is that feasible?

One open question: Helix would like a one-line public commitment that logs related to request metadata will also remain in-region. Can you confirm whether request logs (request IDs, timestamps) are covered by the EU-only processing pledge?

If you can send the DocuSign link for the SCCs addendum and the VPC architecture PDF we can circulate to our infra and procurement.

Thanks,
Anna
Head of Security & Privacy Operations
Helix Health GmbH
Note: Thread attachments referenced above are stubs; actual files to be provided through secure link or DocuSign.
